paper.title: What Memory Do GUI Agents Really Need? From Passive Records to Active Task-Driving States
paper.central_claim: ATMem replaces passive records with active task-driving item states, and interventional cost-aware STR-GRPO learns selective memory use, achieving76.6% AndroidWorld and improved unseen-environment and DataScope execution.

gap.author_gap: Past records provide values without their task roles/status, so agents repeat or omit operations.
gap.checked_gap: Execution-oriented notes and program state are acknowledged by authors. Fixed AWM supplies episodic workflow memory, while MAI-UI already supplies verified SFT/online GRPO and asynchronous infrastructure. Residual is task-local data-state tracking plus explicit ON/OFF memory intervention, not first GUI memory or online RL.

gap.residue: Make execution status explicit and learn selective reliance rather than merely remembering more.
gap.stakes: Multi-entry cross-app tasks need coverage and scope control; DataScope exposes low absolute completion.
gap.method_response: Structured item statuses, verified SFT, paired memory intervention and cost-aware GRPO.
gap.remaining_gap: No separately matched status-only, cost-only and intervention-only controls, no direct state correctness audit; nearest execution-memory fulltexts absent from frozen references.
